title: Three more community projects in the garden
summary:
A small community day: three projects joined the directory, and contributing got one label less complicated.

The Projects directory now includes Telegram AI Chars, FoilAI, and Swapna Shastra Dream Decoder—three more examples of people building strange and useful things on open AI infrastructure.

External issues now share one COMMUNITY label, making incoming feedback and contributions easier to recognize without turning the issue tracker into a taxonomy project.
